title: Reina's Multiplication Facts Adventure: x2, x5, x10
academicTheory: Grounded in Grade 3 multiplication fluency progression: children first need concrete/skip-counting grounding for x2, x5, x10 fact families (CRA framework - Concrete-Representational-Abstract), then need rapid retrieval practice to build automaticity (fluency = accuracy + speed per NCTM), and finally need to transfer facts into two-step word-problem contexts (multiplicative reasoning applied to real quantities, per CCSS.3.OA.A.3). Reina's engagement theory shows strong positive weight for puzzle (5.0, conf .92) and speed (5.0, conf .875) with story mildly positive (2.0, conf .75), while competition, control, and calm are net negative or mixed-negative. Her generated-baseline history shows very low completion (14.3%) and high frustration (0.579) on prior math baseline attempts, and she explicitly disliked the locked 'quest' node (frustration 0.75, dislike). A recent gearworks-crate-builder node was abandoned with frustration 0.75 while skybird-delivery-run (fast, low invalid actions) was completed with low frustration (0.1) -- supporting speed/low-friction mechanics over fiddly construction/gear mechanics. Design favors quick-tap/quick-select retrieval and skip-count visual builders over drag-heavy gear-lock puzzles, replayable 'Show me' demos (never front-loading instructions), and stationary answer targets so the world animates instead of the input.

activities.creatorPrompt: Build a sky-harbor 'Skyglider Skip-Count Run' where a small glider character sits fixed in the center-left of the screen. Ahead of it, present a horizontal row of exactly 3 stationary lantern-platform buttons (data-testid='answer-option') showing candidate numbers continuing a skip-count sequence (by 2s, 5s, or 10s per question). Only one platform per question is correct. The glider and platforms must NOT move location when tapped except the glider's forward hop animation triggered by a correct tap; background clouds/islands should drift to imply motion instead. Include a toggleable 'Show me' demo (data-testid='show-me-toggle') that plays a short replayable animation of the glider hopping on an EXAMPLE sequence only (never the actual question's answer) and a 'Let me try' control (data-testid='let-me-try-toggle') that hands control back to the child. Include a visible sound toggle (data-testid='sound-toggle') and initialize all audio only after the first child gesture. On wrong tap: platform dims/shakes in place, plays a soft recovery chime, no penalty, same options remain. On correct tap: glider hops forward with whoosh sound, lantern bridge segment lights up (progress bar made of lantern icons), question count is exactly 3 matching the questions array. On completing all 3, play a completion fanfare, glider does a loop animation, and show a 'Skip-Count Pilot' badge. Keep this as teaching/practice evidence only -- do not display any mastery or unlock language. The activity title 'Skyglider Skip-Count Run' must be visible in the opening viewport alongside the loaded background artwork.

activities.acceptanceScript: await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/activities/skip-count-glider`); await page.waitForSelector('[data-testid="activity-title"]'); const title = await page.locator('[data-testid="activity-title"]').innerText(); if (!title.includes('Skyglider Skip-Count Run')) throw new Error('Title not visible'); const options = page.locator('[data-testid="answer-option"]'); await options.first().waitFor({state:'visible'}); const count = await options.count(); if (count < 2) throw new Error('Not enough options'); const optionTexts = await options.allTextContents(); const wrongIndex = optionTexts.findIndex(t => t.trim() !== '20'); if (wrongIndex === -1) throw new Error('No wrong option found'); await options.nth(wrongIndex).click(); const recovery = page.locator('[data-testid="recovery-feedback"]'); await recovery.waitFor({state:'visible', timeout:5000}); const stillThere = await options.count(); if (stillThere < 2) throw new Error('Options disappeared after wrong answer'); for (const target of ['20','8','40']) { const opts = page.locator('[data-testid="answer-option"]'); const texts = await opts.allTextContents(); const idx = texts.findIndex(t => t.trim() === target); if (idx === -1) throw new Error('Correct option not found for ' + target); await opts.nth(idx).click(); await page.waitForTimeout(500); } const progress = page.locator('[data-testid="progress-indicator"]'); await progress.waitFor({state:'visible'}); const completion = page.locator('[data-testid="completion-badge"]'); await completion.waitFor({state:'visible', timeout:8000}); const isVisible = await completion.isVisible(); if (!isVisible) throw new Error('Completion not visible'); return {passed:true};

activities.academicTarget: multiplicative word problem solving using x2, x5, x10 facts
activities.mechanic: tap the correct total block to load a crane's crate matching the word problem

visualMock.scene: A harbor crane holds an empty crate above a dock; grouped cargo (pencil boxes or star rows) is displayed beside the crane, with a word problem banner above
visualMock.layout: Word problem and grouped cargo fixed top/center; crane with empty crate fixed center; three stationary total-answer blocks fixed below; background dock workers and gulls animate
visualMock.artworkPrompt: A friendly cartoon harbor crane holding an empty glowing crate above neatly grouped cargo (pencil boxes, star rows), warm dock background with small moving figures and gulls

experience.objective: Tap the total block that matches how many items are in the grouped cargo, to load the crane's crate
experience.childAction: Child taps the one stationary block showing the correct total quantity
experience.worldReaction: Correct block flies up and fills the crate with a satisfying clunk and glow; crane lifts the loaded crate happily; wrong block causes a soft buzz and the crate stays empty
experience.anticipation: The crate pulses gently, showing it is ready and waiting to be filled
experience.progress: A stationary harbor progress shelf gains one more loaded crate icon per correct answer
experience.recovery: Wrong tap: gentle buzz, block returns to its row, crate remains empty and ready, no penalty, try again immediately
experience.reward: After both crates loaded, the crane does a happy swing dance, cheerful music plays, and a 'Crane Master' badge appears

questions.prompt: Mrs. K puts 5 pencils in each of 4 boxes. How many pencils in all?
There are 3 rows of 10 stars. How many stars in all?

acceptanceSteps: launch /activities/word-problem-crane
attempt incorrect block on first problem
verify recovery (buzz, crate empty, block returns)
answer both problems correctly
verify progress shelf update and completion badge visible
activities.creatorPrompt: Build 'Crane Crate Puzzle' using the two exact word problems from the assignment (5 pencils x 4 boxes; 3 rows of 10 stars), one at a time. Show grouped cargo visually matching the problem structure (4 groups of 5 pencil-boxes; 3 rows of 10 stars) fixed near top/center, with a friendly crane holding an empty crate fixed center screen. Present exactly 3 stationary total-answer blocks (data-testid='answer-option') below that the child taps (tap only, no drag) to load the crate. Include 'Show me' demo using a different simple example, and 'Let me try' toggle. Sound toggle visible, audio initializes after first gesture. Wrong tap: buzz, block returns to row, crate stays empty, no penalty. Correct tap: block flies into crate with clunk+glow, crane lifts crate happily, one loaded-crate icon added to a fixed progress shelf. After both problems solved, crane victory dance + music + 'Crane Master' badge. Practice/teaching evidence only, no mastery/unlock claims. Title 'Crane Crate Puzzle' visible in opening viewport with background artwork loaded.
activities.designPrediction: This puzzle-framed word-problem activity will show comparable accuracy to route-a's delivery dash since both use identical single-tap total-selection mechanics; any engagement difference will show in replay/liked signals rather than accuracy given held-constant difficulty.
preserve: single word problem at a time
visually grouped cargo matching problem structure
change: ensure exact assignment wording is preserved verbatim
explore: whether crane/loading framing feels more satisfying than glider/delivery framing to this child
activities.acceptanceScript: await page.goto(`${BASE_URL}/activities/word-problem-crane`); await page.waitForSelector('[data-testid="activity-title"]'); const title=await page.locator('[data-testid="activity-title"]').innerText(); if(!title.includes('Crane Crate Puzzle')) throw new Error('Title missing'); const answers=['20','30']; for(let i=0;i<2;i++){ const opts=page.locator('[data-testid="answer-option"]'); await opts.first().waitFor({state:'visible'}); const texts=await opts.allTextContents(); const correctIdx=texts.findIndex(t=>t.trim()===answers[i]); if(correctIdx===-1) throw new Error('Correct total missing round '+i); if(i===0){ const wrongIdx=texts.findIndex((t,idx)=>idx!==correctIdx); await opts.nth(wrongIdx).click(); const recovery=page.locator('[data-testid="recovery-feedback"]'); await recovery.waitFor({state:'visible',timeout:5000}); const stillThere=await page.locator('[data-testid="answer-option"]').count(); if(stillThere<2) throw new Error('Blocks vanished'); } const opts2=page.locator('[data-testid="answer-option"]'); const texts2=await opts2.allTextContents(); const idx2=texts2.findIndex(t=>t.trim()===answers[i]); await opts2.nth(idx2).click(); await page.waitForTimeout(500);} const completion=page.locator('[data-testid="completion-badge"]'); await completion.waitFor({state:'visible',timeout:8000}); if(!(await completion.isVisible())) throw new Error('Completion not visible'); return {passed:true};
